name: Golviva
description: Football (soccer) match predictions, season projections and player valuations for AI agents: win, draw and loss chances, likeliest scores and scorers and predicted line-ups for every match of 26 leagues, the Champions League, Europa League, Conference League and senior national teams; each club's title, top-four and relegation chances; Golviva's own estimated transfer values with the reasons behind them, scouting and rankings; plus live scores, match centres, league tables, stat leaders and transfer news. 18 read-only tools. Users sign in to a Golviva account with Apple or Google; every account has a free daily allowance of tool calls. Predictions are model probabilities, not betting advice.
author: Golviva
